culm.meaning_en: Visible vertical extent from the image bottom to the highest plant foreground row.

leaves_area.meaning_en: Visible plant foreground as a fraction of the full image; not true plant leaf area.

plant_density.meaning_en: Two-dimensional projected fill: plant foreground divided by its rasterized convex-hull area.

tassel.meaning_en: Manually observed visibility of the apical tassel in the current image: visible or not visible.

ear.meaning_en: Manually observed visibility of the axillary ear in the current image: visible or not visible.

plant_color_development.meaning_en: Yellow plus brown fraction of classifiable plant foreground; visible color only.

manual_annotation_contract.definition: visible means the organ is visible in the current image; not_visible means it is not visible in the current image. No separate reason or obstruction category is recorded.
